flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/schedulers/MonthlyReportJobsScheduler, framework/workflows/paymentReport/{services/MonthlyPaidReportServiceImpl,jobs/MonthlyPaidReportJob,helpers/MonthlyPaidReportHelper}, utilities/emailutility/EmailService, resources/{cron-schedules-prod,application-prod}.properties. ocmsadminui pages/Cron/list/CronList.tsx (trigger only). The other three repos: no code for this story.
note: Story status: Fully paid (status_with_ura). The Monthly Paid Report runs on the 1st at 08:30 for the previous month and is sent as an Excel attachment. But its content does not exactly match the story: (a) 'other agencies (JTC, MND)' is derived from 'PP code not in the REPCCS car park list' and then everything is labelled JTC (MonthlyPaidReportHelper.java:182-202), MND is not distinguished, and the JTC sheet lists only FP, not PRA (line 721); (b) no single sheet holds all story fields: the JTC sheet has no receipt number, payment source, or place name (only PP code), while the eService/AXS/Offline sheets have the receipt but not Vehicle No, Offence Date and Time, or rule code (lines 477-487); ticket OCMS-SR-2026-148 (Vehicle No, Offence Date/Time, LPS, NPS in the monthly report) is recorded as Prod deployed but is not visible in this main commit, the deployed version: cannot verify from repo; (c) the JTC total in Summary uses all JTC records including PRA (lines 224, 394) while the sheet is FP-only; (d) the recipients are a list of individual URA staff emails (application-prod.properties:75), none of which can be confirmed as URA Finance. Other tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-013, OCMS-SR-2026-016, OCMS-SR-2026-088, OCMS-SR-2026-153 (Closed/Prod deployed). email.enableSmtp=false in prod but MONTHLY_PAID_REPORT is in allowedSources (application-prod.properties:80-81); real SMTP delivery: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially (see the Sebagian steps). The monthly job and email delivery exist; the report does not carry all story fields in one list, MND is not distinguished, and URA Finance as recipient is not proven from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS generates the monthly report automatically every month
steps.detail: cron.monthlyreport.schedule=0 30 8 1 * ? and enabled=true in prod; job 2 = Monthly Paid Report; the default period is the previous month (MonthlyPaidReportServiceImpl.java:42). Real server value: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The report lists notices paid during that month
steps.detail: The query selects crs_reason_of_suspension IN ('PRA','FP') with YEAR/MONTH(crs_date_of_suspension) (lines 91-92), so a payment is mapped to a month by its suspension date. Like the daily report, results are deduplicated per notice keeping only the latest transaction (lines 100-128), and URA records with an unknown sender go to uncategorized and are left out of the total (lines 195, 210). Same logic as OCMS43.4 step 2, so the same fit.

steps.step: The report separates collections at other agencies' car parks (JTC, MND)
steps.detail: A notice is treated as another agency's when its PP code is not in the REPCCS car park list (icarparkRepository.findAllCarparkIds, line 160; checked at line 182) and all of them go to the sheet 'JTC Collections' (line 202); MND or other agencies are not distinguished. That sheet lists only FP records (line 721), PRA does not appear. OCMS-SR-2026-088 (closed URA car parks wrongly placed in JTC) is Closed/Prod deployed. The real REPCCS car park list: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The report carries the notice detail fields (notice number, date/time, place, amount paid, payment date, receipt, vehicle, type, fine, rule, payment source, notice status)
steps.detail: The fields are split over two kinds of sheet. The JTC sheet (lines 697-711) has Notice No, Notice Date And Time, PP Code (not the place name), Vehicle No, Vehicle Category and Registration Type, Computer Rule Code, Composition Amount, Amount Paid, Suspension Type + CRS reason (status), and the payment date, but no Receipt No and no payment source. The eService/AXS sheets (lines 477-487) have Receipt No, Amount Paid, Amount payable, PP code, CRS/EPR reason, but no Vehicle No, Offence Date and Time, vehicle type, or rule code. Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-148 asked for Vehicle No and Offence Date and Time in the monthly report (Prod deployed per the ticket) but they are not in this main commit: which version is running: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The report gives monthly totals per channel and for other agencies
steps.detail: The Summary sheet computes counts per channel and 'Total Amount Collected on Behalf of JTC' from jtcCollectionRecords (line 394, calculateTotalAmount uses amount_paid). jtcCollectionCount uses all JTC records (line 224) including PRA, while the JTC sheet is FP-only (line 721); the daily report uses an FP-only count (around DailyPaidReportHelper.java:198). So the monthly JTC summary figure can differ from the sheet content. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-013 (JTC total $0 in the daily report) is Closed.

steps.step: OCMS produces the monthly Excel file and emails it as an attachment
steps.detail: MonthlyPaidReportJob builds the workbook (sheets Summary, eService, AXS, Offline, JTC, Refund; MonthlyPaidReportHelper.java:262-276) and sends it through EmailService with the attachment and source MONTHLY_PAID_REPORT (lines 215, 227); there are separate emails for no data and failure (lines 285, 327). email.enableSmtp=false in prod but MONTHLY_PAID_REPORT is in email.smtp.allowedSources (application-prod.properties:80-81), so it is not held back. Real SMTP delivery: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The email is sent to URA Finance
steps.detail: Recipients come from email.report.paymentreport.monthly.recipients (MonthlyPaidReportJob.java:51-52), which holds 21 individual @ura.gov.sg addresses (application-prod.properties:75). No address or group can be confirmed as URA Finance; ticket OCMS-SR-2026-016 added JTC reconciliation officers, not Finance. The recipient list running on the server: cannot verify from repo.
